transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been feeling constantly depressed and sad for a really long time now. It has been going on continuously for about two years and four months, and I just can't seem to shake this low mood.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful life event or major change, or did they come on without a clear trigger?

I can't really think of any specific trigger or stressful event that started this. It feels like these feelings just developed gradually over the last two years and four months without any clear cause.
During these past two years and four months, have there been any stretches of two months or longer when you were not feeling depressed most of the time?
No, I haven't had any periods of two months or longer where I felt better. The low mood and sadness have been completely continuous and persistent throughout this entire time.

During this time, have there ever been periods of at least two weeks when your depression became much worse, with symptoms like losing interest in almost everything, major sleep or appetite changes, low energy, guilt, poor concentration, or thoughts of death?

No, I haven't really experienced periods where it got much worse with those specific symptoms like appetite changes, guilt, or thoughts of death. Instead, my feelings of sadness, low energy, and emotional emptiness have just been a constant, steady baseline for the past two years and four months.

Along with the low mood, have you had at least two of these most of the time: poor appetite or overeating, trouble sleeping or sleeping too much, low self-esteem, poor concentration or trouble making decisions, or feeling hopeless?
I haven't really noticed or experienced those specific symptoms. My appetite and sleep seem okay, and I wouldn't say I struggle with low self-esteem or feeling hopeless.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities you usually enjoy for at least two weeks at a time?
No, I haven't really experienced a loss of interest or pleasure in my usual activities. I still try to do the things I normally enjoy, even if my mood is constantly low.
How much has this low mood affected your daily functioning, like your work, relationships, or ability to take care of responsibilities?

My daily functioning has been heavily impacted because I have so much difficulty performing normal activities due to a severe decline in my energy. Even minor tasks leave me feeling physically exhausted, and trying to concentrate on anything just drains me mentally. I just feel completely worn out all the time.
Do you have trouble concentrating or making decisions most days during this period?
Yes, I do find it really hard to concentrate. Whenever I try to think or focus on something, my mind tires out very quickly and I feel mentally exhausted.
Most days during this period, have you felt low self-esteem or hopeless about the future?
No, I haven't particularly felt low self-esteem or hopeless about the future. I'm not really sure about those feelings, as they haven't been a part of what I've been experiencing.
Most days during this period, have you had poor appetite or overeaten?
I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my appetite during this time. I wouldn't say I've been overeating or eating less than usual, it has stayed pretty much the same.
